## Problem and result / 问题与结果

Describe what triggers the problem and how this change helps an author.

## Validation / 验证

List the checks actually run and relevant results; distinguish fixture and real-model tests.

## Data and compatibility / 数据与兼容性

Explain migrations, version / recovery impact, host compatibility or provider costs if relevant.

- [ ] No credentials, private manuscripts or local runtime data included.
- [ ] Exact evidence, project isolation, draft recovery and pre-edit versions preserved.
- [ ] Translated installation / privacy guidance updated when affected.
- [ ] Reused content has redistribution rights and attribution.
